Ultimate Smile Design was created by Master Ceramist Haresh Savani after years of seeing inconsistencies in conventional smile makeovers. He realised that beautiful, natural smiles aren't created by technology or materials alone — they require a standardised, planning-first approach.

To clarify, USD is not a clinic or a standalone lab — it is the premium aesthetic brand of Advance Dental Export (ADE) Laboratory.

user_questions: What is an Authorized USD Smile Designer?
Can my own dentist become authorized?
voice_response:
An Authorized Ultimate Smile Designer is a licensed dentist who has successfully completed the USD training and certification program. During this program, dentists learn the official USD philosophy, treatment protocols, digital planning workflow, and aesthetic principles developed by Master Ceramist Haresh Savani. After authorization, they are qualified to provide treatment using the official USD protocol.

Think of it this way: every chef knows how to cook, but a Master chef is recognised for consistency, creativity, and attention to detail. Similarly, while many dentists perform smile makeovers, an Authorized USD Smile Designer has received specialised training and follows a standardised protocol designed to deliver consistent, natural, and highly aesthetic results.
